segments.oily: One reviewer with combo-oily skin found the mask improved both the oily and the dry patches on her face without breaking her out.
segments.dry: Numerous reviewers describe dry, flaky, or dehydrated skin and report the mask left it noticeably softer, plumper, and more hydrated by morning, with several calling it their go-to for dry skin.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin noted stronger, more visible results on drier areas and on her hands than on the parts of her face already balanced.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin (including one with lifelong rosacea) report the mask felt soothing and calming with no irritation, though one sensitive-skin reviewer warns the rich formula clogged her pores overnight.
segments.mature: One reviewer over 25 highlights the mask's collagen and moisture benefits as valuable for her anti-aging routine, and another mentions being glad Peace Out offers an anti-aging option.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using the mask for anti-aging purposes report plumper, firmer-looking skin and appreciate the peptide/collagen content, describing visible improvement in fullness and smoothness by morning.
concerns.dehydration: This is the most consistently praised effect: reviewers across skin types report significantly more hydrated, softer, plumper skin the morning after use, with many calling it their most hydrating mask.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers with redness or rosacea-prone skin report visibly calmer, less red skin by morning thanks to centella asiatica and niacinamide; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers focused on barrier repair describe the mask as soothing and strengthening, with reduced irritation and a calmer, more resilient-feeling complexion after overnight use.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers mention breakouts specifically: one with acne-prone skin reports the mask helped clear breakouts, while another reports zero new breakouts even while traveling; no reviewer reports the mask causing new spots.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers report calmer, less irritated-looking blemishes and improved clarity overnight; one sensitive reviewer, however, reports the mask was too rich and clogged her pores.
concerns.oiliness: Only one reviewer references oiliness directly, describing combination oily-and-dry skin where the mask balanced both without adding excess oil or greasiness.

aspects.libelle: Leaves plump, glowy skin by morning
Price considered high for frequent use
Can clog pores if left too long

extraits.titre: would be great for dry skin
extraits.texte: Peace Out gifted me their Bio-Collagen Recovery Mask in exchange for this honest review. First off, I was skeptical that I would be able to sleep with the mask on as it is quite moist when you first put it on. But once I left it on for about 30 minutes, it dried a little and actually attached well to the skin and stayed on through the night. I also put the little cutouts for the mouth and eyes on my hands and felt them getting hydrated right away. In the morning, I noticed my skin feeling more moisturized. However, I'm currently in a "good skin phase" where my skin barrier seems healthy and my combination skin balanced, so I noticed a much bigger result on my hands. So, personally I feel this would be a great mask for dry skin but you'll get less results if your skin is in good shape, if that makes any sense.

extraits.titre: First time trying out an overnight mask like this!
extraits.texte: I love the mask comes in 2 pieces, as it fits very comfortably. It felt so nice and cooling , and once it was on, I barely noticed it. I left it on overnight (as recommended), and when I peeled it off in the morning, my skin looked noticeably plumper and refreshed. It gave me that well rested glow that I usually don't get without a full night of sleep. What really impressed me was how hydrating it was. My my skin felt soft, bouncy, and moisturized without feeling greasy. I also liked that it has niacinamide and Centella Asiatica, which helped calm down some redness I had around my cheeks. As someone with acne-prone skin, I was a little nervous about trying something new overnight, but this didn't cause any irritation or breakouts. Instead, it actually made my skin feel soothed and clearer-looking. I highly recommend it! Complimentary from Peace Out Skincare.

Gifted by peaceoutskincare. I was gifted this mask to try, and I'm impressed! As someone with sensitive, reactive skin (lifelong rosacea), I'm always a little cautious about overnight masks. This one surprised me in a good way. It felt very soothing and hydrating. The sheet material adheres well without slipping, and it had a cooling, calming feel. I wore it overnight, and by the morning my skin looked plumper, calmer, and more refreshed. I like that it has good ingredients like niacinamide and peptides. If you're looking for a mask that hydrates, soothes, and helps skin look healthier, this one is definitely worth trying. #PeaceOutSkincare #OvernightMask #HydratedSkin #SkincareReview #Gifted

Gifted by peace out This mask to repaired and rejuvenated my skin while I slept. The bio-collagen, peptides, and antioxidants, worked to reduce redness, soothe irritation, and promote a more even skin tone. It was helpful for calming my breakouts and healing blemishes overnight. It's hydrating left my skin feeling soft and supple. However, it was too rich, and it clog pores overnight. Individual results may vary, and it's always wise to patch-test, especially if you have sensitive skin like me.

I have pretty dry skin and I am always searching for something that gives me lasting hydration. I started using the Peace Out Overnight Bio Collagen Recovery Mask a couple weeks ago and noticed a real difference after the first few nights. My skin felt softer and looked a little more plump in the morning which is huge for me since dryness usually makes me look dull. The texture is silky and creamy without feeling heavy, and it sinks in nicely as I sleep.

I have oily, acne-prone skin and usually worry about masks breaking me out, but this overnight collagen mask was such a surprise! I wore it while traveling (when my skin normally flares up), and I woke up with smoother, calmer skin and zero new breakouts. My face looked refreshed, balanced, and glowy—like I'd just had a facial. Just wish I could get a pack of multiple. Gifted by Peace Out.

I have combo oily skin and the parts that aren't oily are actually super dry. It's hard to manage. This sheet mask helped improve BOTH areas. I haven't found a product that can do both so this became a gem for my routine. Complimentary from Peace
